question: What Is a DCS System and How Does It Work?
body_html:
A distributed control system (DCS) is a computer based system that controls plant processes by spreading control across many controllers instead of one central unit, so one failure does not stop the whole plant.

LevelFunction
Level 0Field devices: sensors, transducers, actuators
Level 1Controllers and I/O racks
Level 2Supervisory computers for operators
Level 3Production control and coordination
Level 4Plant management and scheduling
